title: SAAbs
summary: A Software Architecture Abstraction Tool with a bundled Java component (com.sdmetrics) that appears to be the unrelated UML design-metrics tool SDMetrics, not the SDV-family sdmetrics package. No genuine connection to the Synthetic Data Vault's sdmetrics library was found in the evidence.
evidence: rversedesigner/src/com/sdmetrics directory name matches Java package for the unrelated 'SDMetrics' UML design-metrics tool, no SDV pattern hits
needs: Confirm com.sdmetrics is the third-party UML metrics tool (Wüst) unrelated to SDV's sdmetrics package.
